item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL operated under a statutory framework aligned with the 2019–2024 National Development Plan and Social Welfare Sector Program, with a formal mandate to measure poverty, evaluate social policy, and issue evidence-based recommendations for decision-makers. This documents an institutional policy architecture during López Obrador’s 2023 administration, but does not establish his personal direction or use of the evidence.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.7","6B.5","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The framework and 2023 activities directly cover the evaluation year, while the cited planning instruments span 2019–2024.","ruler_attribution":"Indirect institutional attribution only; the document describes CONEVAL’s statutory mandate and alignment with federal planning, not a personal López Obrador decision.","limitations":["No evidence here about López Obrador’s personal compliance with, response to, or implementation of CONEVAL recommendations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":8,"end_unit":10,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL reported that national labor poverty fell from 40.1% to 37.3% between the third quarters of 2022 and 2023, real per-capita labor income rose 11.3%, and employment increased by 1.7 million; however, multidimensional poverty data showed extreme poverty remained nearly unchanged from 7.0% in 2018 to 7.1% in 2022, while health-service deprivation rose from 16.2% to 39.1%.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.2","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The labor-market results cover 2022–2023 and were reported in the 2023 assessment; multidimensional poverty results use 2018–2022 data available during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are national outcomes during López Obrador’s administration, but the source does not identify causal responsibility or separate federal policy effects from external and subnational factors.","limitations":["The document warns that the ITLP is a short-term approximation and not equivalent to multidimensional poverty.","The multidimensional indicators lag the 2023 period."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":13,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL found substantial long-run reductions in social lag: 80.4% of Mexican localities improved their social-lag grade by 2020, but 7,136 high- or very-high-lag localities remained, including 5,258 with persistent lag. Program coverage was uneven: the older-person pension reached every municipality but had a beneficiary-to-poverty ratio below one in 72.9% of municipalities; disability and Sembrando Vida coverage also fell below the local poverty share in many municipalities.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.10","6B.2","6B.3","6B.7","6B.10","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The evidence was published or updated in 2023 but most outcome measures cover earlier periods through 2020 or 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The programs were federal programs of López Obrador’s administration, but the source does not prove presidential authorship, targeting intent, or causation.","limitations":["Municipal coverage ratios do not measure benefit adequacy, take-up, or welfare effects.","Most outcome data predate 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":17,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The updated Social Rights Information System contained 179 indicators, including measures of effective access and inequality for women Indigenous people, youth, older people, people with disabilities, and gender gaps. From 2018 to 2022, the share of older people receiving a pension at least equal to the national income-poverty line rose from 26.0% to 35.2%, while major disparities persisted, including labor income at or above that line for 33.8% of employed Indigenous women versus 62.8% of non-Indigenous women.","question_ids":["5B.7","5B.8","6B.3","6B.5","6B.8","6B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The system was updated and published during 2023 using 2016–2022 series.","ruler_attribution":"The indicators describe policy-relevant outcomes during López Obrador’s administration but do not attribute changes specifically to him.","limitations":["The source reports indicators and disparities, not a causal evaluation of federal policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":20,"end_unit":24,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL published monitoring of the 2019–2024 social programs and found uneven implementation: among 263 indicators for six-year targets, 47% showed important progress while 53% were insufficient, lagging, or very lagging; among 141 indicators affected by the pandemic, only 27% were classified as surpassed and 47% as very lagging.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","5B.10","6B.5","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The monitoring report was developed and published in 2023 using information through the end of 2022.","ruler_attribution":"The monitored programs derive from the federal administration’s planning framework, but the report does not establish personal López Obrador responsibility for each result.","limitations":["The source does not identify which programs or indicators account for the aggregate classifications.","Pandemic effects complicate attribution."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":27,"end_unit":34,"fact_summary":"Federal social-program budgets increased substantially in 2023: the 121-program social budget rose 16.2% nominally, and the 15 priority programs rose 28.1% nominally from 2022. The 16 priority programs had a budget of 512.806 billion pesos, but only 69% had results orientation, 50% effectively measured results, and 38% showed logical linkage between components and objectives.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.5","8B.2","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Budget figures and program-quality assessments concern fiscal year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are federal budget and program-management choices during López Obrador’s administration, but the document does not establish his personal role in individual allocations or design decisions.","limitations":["Nominal budget increases do not demonstrate real increases in service quality or welfare.","Program-quality measures concern design and monitoring, not necessarily final outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":49,"end_unit":50,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL reported strong execution of its own evaluation and monitoring program in 2023: 94.9% of registered improvement commitments were completed, 95.3% of evaluations were disseminated, 173 mandated evaluations met CONEVAL criteria, and use of CONEVAL information rose 34.4% over the 2012–2022 average. At the same time, indicators were approved for only 45 of 58 social programs.","question_ids":["5B.7","6B.5","8B.5","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"All reported performance figures concern 2023.","ruler_attribution":"This supports the functioning of an autonomous evaluation institution during López Obrador’s administration, not personal presidential conduct.","limitations":["Institutional output and dissemination do not prove that federal decision-makers adopted or implemented the recommendations.","The document is a self-evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":50,"end_unit":53,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL reported that external and internal oversight actions were completed without unresolved findings: the ASF’s 2023 audit found no observations, the internal audit of program P003 received a clean opinion, and the personnel-contracting audit found no definitive findings. The institution also reported completion of all 21 internal-control improvement actions and 100% completion of risk-mitigation actions.","question_ids":["4B.4","5B.5","5B.7","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The audit, control, and risk-management results were reported for 2023, though some audits examined earlier fiscal periods.","ruler_attribution":"The evidence concerns CONEVAL’s oversight and internal controls during the administration; it does not show López Obrador’s personal cooperation or independence from oversight.","limitations":["A self-reported clean audit result does not establish absence of misconduct elsewhere in the federal government.","The source does not assess presidential or ministerial conduct directly."]},{"source_id":"SRC-251d486db52fa825","start_unit":57,"end_unit":60,"fact_summary":"CONEVAL reported institutional ethics and transparency measures in 2023, including a revised code of conduct, zero-tolerance statements on corruption and sexual harassment, ethics-committee renewal, conflict-of-interest training, 149 of 155 information requests answered during the year, and compliance with transparency-portal updates; one of three review appeals revoked a CONEVAL response.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.6","5B.5","6B.7","7B.3","7B.6","7B.7","7B.10"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The measures and transparency activity occurred during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"These are CONEVAL institutional practices and cannot be attributed directly to López Obrador’s personal conduct or federal-wide integrity.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether the measures were independently effective or applied across the wider administration.","One appeal was revoked, indicating at least one transparency response required correction."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied document is a CONEVAL institutional self-evaluation, not a direct biography, speech record, legal record, or independent assessment of Andrés Manuel López Obrador.","It provides substantial evidence for social policy, welfare outcomes, evaluation capacity, transparency, and implementation, but little or no material evidence for nuclear risk, international peace, domestic violence, electoral competition, personal integrity, or direct presidential crisis decisions.","Facts are therefore attributed to the federal-policy or institutional context only where appropriate; personal ruler attribution remains limited.","No score is assigned."]}
